Title: Missed fall? Dormant seed once soil is 40°F or below
Description: Tall fescue and bluegrass stop establishing once soil falls to 50°F. Regional cutoffs, what each week of delay costs, and when to switch to dormant seeding.
Keywords: lawn care, fall and winter yard, outdoor maintenance

Title: Brown patch: water before sunrise, not every evening
Description: A brown spot that watering won't fix is usually a coverage gap, grubs, dog urine, or brown patch fungus. The tests and thresholds that tell which one.

Title: Flapper over 5 years old? Fluidmaster says just replace it
Description: A toilet that refills for a few seconds on its own is leaking from the tank. How to tell flapper, refill tube, or seal, and what the leak wastes.

Title: Wildfire area? IBHS calls for metal gutters, kept clear
Description: Yes: guards cut debris but don't end upkeep. What to check, why wildfire areas need metal guards and clear gutters, and the ladder math to do it safely.

Title: Hot to warm can cut washer energy in half, per ENERGY STAR
Description: No agency sets a use count for towels. When a bath towel needs washing now, what CDC says about workout and shared towels, and what hot water costs.
